parsed.rationale: Both records are `type-alias-object` kinds with empty `fields_or_signature` lists, meaning there is no shared structural body to extract — each is a thin type alias living in a distinct app target (`app:WatchXYC` at `WXYC/WatchXYC/RootTabView.swift` and `app:iOS` at `WXYC/iOS/Views/Root/RootTabView.swift`). The two targets serve fundamentally different platforms (watchOS vs. iOS), so the name collision is coincidental: both need a root tab view concept but their concrete implementations are necessarily platform-specific. No `structural_evidence` fields (jaccard, shared_field_count, shared_ancestor) carry any signal, confirming there is no shared shape to consolidate. Merging or extracting these into a common package would couple platform-divergent UI code without benefit.
